1 forbidden decision site(s). A deprecated literal inside a comparison recognizes ONLY the old spelling, so the CANONICAL name silently fails while the old one keeps working (B-cdf6 F-065/F-061/F-062/F-068). Route the test through the read-both helpers in packages/main/src/core/brand-paths.ts — isStateDirPath / isAdapterDirPath / isConfigFilename / isManifestFilename — which accept both spellings by construction. Declaring the literal (a DEPRECATED_* constant) or naming it in a deprecation notice is still allowed; only using it as a decision is forbidden.
